symptom: A combo box with filterType: 'none' failed mx check with CE0463: mxcli wrote an empty text template into noOptionsText, which Studio Pro stores as null when the editor hides it; `widget describe combobox` reported 30 of 32 hide-rules recognized.
cause: Combo box 2.10's editorConfig hides noOptionsText under a two-condition guard, `"none"===t.filterType&&"rowclick"!==t.selectionMethod&&x.hidePropertiesIn(...)`. parseGuard stopped at the `&` boundary and lifted no rule for an `&&` chain, though WidgetVisibilityRule.And already expresses conjunctions (else-chains used it).
fix: andChainTerms reads the conjuncts before the guard back to the statement boundary; every one must be a representable condition and the chain must start a statement, otherwise no rule as before. Combo box now reads 31 of 32.
insight: Probe the reader with the minimal JS shape before reading the 2000-line parser: a one-condition guard lifted and the same guard with one more `&&` did not, which located the gap in one run. Proven end to end with mx check 11.12.6: CE0463 at comboFilterNone without the fix, 0 errors with it.
test: mdl/executor/editorconfig_and_chain_2264_test.go TestEditorConfig_AndChainGuard (controls: an unreadable conjunct, a chain inside a guarded group, a chain behind ||)
